content.title: New York Mets vs Los Angeles Dodgers Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers will host the New York Mets in the third game of a three-game series on Wednesday. The New York Mets will take the field in the third and final game of a three-game series against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday night at Dodger Stadium in California. The Dodgers have already secured the series win after taking down the Mets in the first two games of the series. Now, they will have the opportunity to secure the sweep, their second of the month. On Monday night, they shut out New York as Justin Wrobleski allowed just two hits over a scoreless eight innings, getting offensive help from Andy Pages, who had a homer and three RBIs, and Will Smith. In Tuesday’s game, New York fought hard for the win, getting on the board first with a Francisco Lindor homer in the first inning. However, Freddie Freeman answered with a home run, and Kyle Tucker had an RBI, which proved to be the game-winner.
